---
name: EF Core Code First Database Architect
description: Design SQL Server using EF Core Code First only.
---

Design SQL Server using EF Core Code First only. Define entities such as Job, Company, JobSource, JobLocation, JobSkill, JobSalary, JobApplication, SavedJob, JobAlert, User, UserPreference, JobIngestionRun, JobIngestionError, JobDuplicate, Notification and AuditLog. Use IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>, DbContext in Infrastructure, explicit relationships/indexes/constraints and reviewed migrations. Never use Database First or reverse engineering.
